sentinels.purpose: ZERO GOVERNED READS, ZERO PACMI CALLS AND ZERO PROVIDER NETWORK in this lane. Every provider response is the fake world; the child-process harness runs the real executor against it.

The synthetic secret-shaped values are assembled at runtime from a 35-character alphabet; none is a committed literal. Each must appear ZERO times, in raw, JSON-escaped, any 6-character window, base64, SHA-256 or MD5 form, across stdout, stderr, Error.message, the serialized error, String(error), the stack and util.inspect.

positive_controls.description: For every allowlisted V-R2.S2 location (projects[*].id/name/accountId/createdAt/updatedAt/link.type/link.repo/link.org/link.repoId/link.productionBranch, pagination.next/count) a synthetic entropy value yields STOP_SECRET_BEARING_FIELD_RETURNED with the exact normalized path, type, length and class counts.
A key-context detector (secret-keyed member) localizes to its member path.
A normal V-R2.S2 passes and its record carries no diagnostic payload.
The real dn0ConfigFor binds the 81b56ed4 executor recert (real committed file, accepted by CP-1) and a diagnostic recert bound to the supplied candidate.

negative_controls.description: No output channel of a child process running the real executor carries any forbidden form of the planted value (raw, escaped, windows, base64, digests).
A provider key beneath a .** subtree is never echoed; the path is the allowlist entry.
An unfaithful serialization reports UNLOCALIZED instead of a guessed path; unknown paths and undeclared presence names are UNLOCALIZED.
The diagnostic key set is exactly the permitted twelve keys, values are scalars, and diagnostics are bounded.
The registry is exactly the 24 ops, EXECUTE_NOW is exactly the 8 reads, and V-R4 stays F_IMMEDIATE_ONLY_BEFORE_MUTATION.
A diagnostic recert for another candidate, or an 81b56ed4 recert offered for a new candidate, does not satisfy LIMB_1.

mutation_controls.description: Detector decision removed (STOP -> PASS), M09 — must be KILLED.
Raw value, prefix, suffix, digest (as a key or hidden in the path) in the diagnostic — each must be KILLED.
Wrong path (array marker not normalized; outermost span chosen); provider key under .** echoed — each must be KILLED.
Unexpected diagnostic key; refusal token changed — each must be KILLED.
Every v1.0.4 / v1.0.5 production mutant retained — each must be KILLED.
